description: Third-party reporters beside Jest 30.5.2 on 20 small files (T11.9, B23a): the default reporter, a `summary` with `summaryThreshold: 5`, `github-actions`, jest-junit 17, jest-silent-reporter, jest-html-reporters, vscode-jest 6.4.4's own reporter and jest-sonar-reporter as `testResultsProcessor`, with `maxWorkers: 1`. The files cover a pass, nested describes, failing toBe, toEqual, toThrow and mock counts, skip and todo, each, test.failing, a stored snapshot, console output, a retry, an import failure, an all-skipped file and a failing beforeAll and afterAll. Every stream and report is recorded as the runner wrote it: the work directory as `<root>` and times masked, nothing else. Read by `provino`'s `reporters-third-party.test.ts`. The vscode-jest reporter is UPSTREAM.md's.
